title: Synthesia vs HeyGen: Which AI Avatar Tool Wins?
hook: Two AI avatars walk into a studio. Only one leaves as champion.

battle.tagline: Which AI avatar tool actually deserves your money?

rounds.title: Avatar realism
rounds.aPoint: Polished, corporate ready avatars built for consistent professional output
rounds.bPoint: More expressive avatars with stronger lip sync and emotion

rounds.title: Ease of use
rounds.aPoint: Simple templates aimed at business and training teams
rounds.bPoint: Slightly more features, so a touch more setup time

rounds.title: Customisation
rounds.aPoint: Solid custom avatar options but slower turnaround times
rounds.bPoint: Faster custom avatar creation with more flexible editing tools

battle.verdict: HeyGen wins overall for creators wanting flexibility and speed, but Synthesia still leads for large businesses needing polished, template driven training videos.

narration.text: Two AI avatar tools, one big question. Can Synthesia or HeyGen actually replace a real presenter on camera.
Round one is realism. Synthesia looks polished and corporate, built for training videos. HeyGen edges ahead here with sharper lip sync and more natural expression.
Round two is ease of use. Synthesia keeps things simple with clean templates for business teams. HeyGen has more features but takes a little longer to learn, so this round goes to Synthesia.
Round three is customisation. Synthesia offers solid custom avatars but production can be slow. HeyGen lets you build and edit custom avatars faster, taking this round too.

Overall, HeyGen wins for creators who want speed and flexibility, though Synthesia still leads for big companies needing consistent training content. Which one would you pick? Drop it in the comments, and follow for daily AI battles.
